Parameter settings: The 99.5th percentile of available power among records meeting the completeness criteria with positive available power in the historical calibration period ending at slot 2976, with a lower bound of 1 MW. The scale was then held fixed.
Gap threshold $\tau_{n}=0.03s_{n}$ and smoothing parameter $\kappa_{n}=0.02s_{n}$. Curtailment status is determined from the current sampling interval alone.

Each classifier uses 220 boosting iterations, a learning rate of 0.035, at most 16 leaf nodes, at least 35 samples per leaf, and an $L_{2}$ penalty with coefficient 0.04. The local-only classifier and the classifier using local and cross-farm inputs use the same settings.
Inputs are scaled as in Table C3. The classifier uses balanced class weights, an $L_{2}$ penalty with inverse regularization strength $C=1$, and at most 1,000 iterations.

Component: Pooling of scores from multiple sources
Parameter settings: The pool contains three classifier scores and four rule-based scores. Historical curtailment fractions use rolling windows of 16 and 96 intervals. The AP-based weights have a lower bound of $\epsilon_{q}=10^{-6}$.

The pooled score is clipped to $[\epsilon_{q},1-\epsilon_{q}]$ before the logit transform. Calibration minimizes summed binary cross-entropy with $\mu_{q}=1$ in at most 500 iterations. The calibration set must contain both states, and the standard deviation of the pooled score must exceed $10^{-8}$. Only a positive fitted slope is accepted.

The model uses 320 trees of depth 6, a learning rate of 0.04, and weighted absolute error loss. Predictions are clipped at zero from below, and the forecast increment is shrunk using $\lambda_{A}=0.75$.

Component: Direct CatBoost forecast of actual wind power
Parameter settings: The model uses 240 trees of depth 7, a learning rate of 0.04, and weighted absolute error loss. Predictions are clipped at zero from below.

Component: Sample weights and random seed for both CatBoost models
Parameter settings: Each sample is weighted by the ratio of its farm power scale $s_{n}$ to the mean power scale across training samples. Both models use the random seed 20260914.

The smoothing parameter is $\varepsilon_{A}=0.005$ and the regularization coefficient for non-intercept terms is $\mu_{A}=0.1$. Coefficients are initialized at zero and updated in 18 reweighting iterations. The residual normalized by the farm power scale is clipped with limit $c_{A}=0.1$ and the correction strength is $\alpha_{A}=0.5$.

The smoothing parameter is $\varepsilon_{P}=0.005$ and the regularization coefficient for non-intercept terms is $\mu_{P}=0.1$. Coefficients are initialized at zero and updated in 18 reweighting iterations. The intercept is unpenalized.

The two hidden layers have 32 and 16 neurons, respectively, with hyperbolic tangent activations and a linear output. Training uses weighted absolute error loss and AdamW for 40 epochs, with a batch size of 512, learning rate $3\times 10^{-4}$, and weight decay $10^{-4}$. The outputs of three independently trained networks with seeds 20260914, 20260915, and 20260916 are averaged.

Component: Magnitude of the joint correction to actual wind power
Parameter settings: The linear and neural candidate residuals are normalized by the farm power scale and clipped with the same limit $c_{P}=0.025$. A correction strength of $\alpha_{P}=1$ introduces no additional scaling. Each residual is converted back to power units and added to $B$, and the forecast is clipped at zero from below.
